what: docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md lines 88-89 (backdating) say an lru function value is hashed when it is made. The engine now hashes it when it is evicted, and hashes a rerun value only for a row that was evicted (db/function.rs evict and finish, test an_evictable_function_hashes_its_value_only_when_evicted). Please reword those lines; they are outside The contract, so I left them.

docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md backdating bullet reworded: an lru value is hashed as it is evicted (hash kept in its row), a rerun of an evicted row hashes its new value to compare, a value kept in memory is never hashed; matches db/function.rs and the test an_evictable_function_hashes_its_value_only_when_evicted.
